main_text.p: Adhærendum ecclesia ita, ut evidenter probari possit successio ordinaria: & comprimus celebre esse illud Tertulliani, præscript. 32. Cedant inquit, hæretici origines suarum ecclesiarum, evolvant ordine episcoporum, & per successionem ab initio decurrentem, an primus ille episcopus aliquam ab apostolicis viris habeat auctoritatem. Resp. Non sufficit successio personæ, sed comprimis attendendum est ad doctrinam. Audiatur itaque Tertullianus, qui ibidem, ipsa, inquit, doctrina hæreticorum cum apostolica comparata, de diversitate & contrarietate suâ pronunciabit. Item paulo post. Licet ecclesiæ nullum ab apostolis aut apostolicis viris auctorem suum proferant, tamen in eadem fide conspirantes non minus apostolicæ reputantur, propter consanguinitatem doctrinæ. Idem inculcat Irenæus libr.3. cap.3. Iis presbyteris obaudiendum est, qui cum episcopatus successione charisma veritatis certum acceperint. & libr.4. cap.43. Successio sedis est

page.notes: The opening word carries a decorative manicule (pointing hand) at its left; not transcribed as text. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at the head and in the upper text; not transcribed. The running head is absent. Words marked "comprimis" and "comprimus" are printed as they appear; the form "comprimus" in the first lines and "comprimis" later are both read from the scan. The scan is slightly blurred around "charisma" and "certum"; these readings are the most likely but not certain.
